annotations.title: Send a test copy of a broadcast

description: Send the broadcast to your own verified addresses to check how it renders, without mailing the audience. Prefer this before send_broadcast — it is reversible in the sense that nobody on the list receives anything, and it leaves the broadcast a draft. Recipients must be on a domain verified on the account; anything else is refused. Works on the free plan, unlike send_broadcast.

to.description: 1-5 addresses, each on a domain verified on this account.
